source.MQ: Only acronym supplied; no formula/reference on current page.
source.evidence_policy: Official page retrieved HTTP 200 on checked date; raw page retained locally, not bundled. Public source URL and retrieved-byte hash supplied.

status_semantics.PASS: Specific scoped evidence verified, not a jury score or perfection claim.
status_semantics.FAIL: An explicit testable claim has a demonstrated counterexample.
status_semantics.LIMITED: Evidence supports the stated scope but not a stronger claim.
status_semantics.UNVERIFIED: Evidence or external definition unavailable; not an implemented-code failure.
status_semantics.NOT_REQUIRED: Not an individual condition imposed by the official clustering page.

official_required.test: Document source, data semantics, ID/year keys and traceable input hashes.
Municipal nodes, economic attributes, explicit proximity edge rule, a sequence of dates and documented sensitivity to edge construction.
Grouping plus explicit time tracking; interpret observed consumer profiles and assess evidence for real local-economy types without substituting expenditure resemblance for industrial structure.
official_required.remaining: Wage association alone is insufficient for a production taxonomy; report genuine external economic patterns and their limits.

official_required.condition: ICVI SW, CH, S_Dbw, AVI, AVU, MQ
official_required.test: Common reference spaces/graphs across comparators, named formula/convention, explicit undefined statuses; no silent MQ replacement.
official_required.remaining: Exact official MQ is UNVERIFIED, nonblocking for code acceptance but prevents complete six-metric claim.

official_required.test: Retain accepted alternatives and negative outcomes; new transformed variants compared in both their own and common frozen space.
GitHub repository, YAML/JSON configuration, run instructions, short Russian methodological report and PDF or interactive landing.
official_required.remaining: Reviewer view access is separate from private repository existence and remains UNVERIFIED for submission; no privacy changes authorized.

not_individually_required: Zero uncertainty or a production service

mandatory_for_claim: Fit cutoff and fitted input cohort recorded
Changing excluded future data leaves fitted scaler/calendar/SPD matrix/centres unchanged
Saved month correction applied to each row before annual median
Inductive results unchanged by batch composition/chunking/input order
Missing or unsupported calendar month behavior explicit
Separate transductive drift diagnostic never labelled forecast or train-only correction
Every expense representation fit excludes the heldout region, including initialization
Outcome-missing eligible training expense entities retained
Heldout expense or outcome mutations leave fitted fold state unchanged
No target-selected clustering candidate or controls/hyperparameters
Training-only encoding/scaling for economic probe
Single heldout predictions do not depend on other heldout rows
All folds/outcomes/failed folds reported
Missing/absent clusters do not silently change design semantics
2023 probe, controls, representation and source-year cohort frozen
2024 outcomes used only for scoring
2024 prediction output unchanged by 2024 outcome values
Overlap and source coverage exclusions stated
Retrospective completed expense cohort and prior inspection disclosed
Computed only after predictions fixed
Separate from absolute log-wage errors
Regional outcome means unavailable at deployment; score is pairwise/ranking diagnostic
No claim of calibrated regional-level forecast from centered errors
Fixed candidate search and stopping rules recorded before new fits
Absolute baselines and all three fixed alpha values retained
Fitted-space gains not substituted for common-space gains
Changed occupancy/CH/definedness guards shown, without pretending they are official rules
Economic superiority requires actual paired evidence; intervals including zero are not a positive finding
Fix eligible cohort using controls before observing sector targets
Predict every eligible heldout entity, including missing targets and all-missing regions
Evaluate loss-difference endpoints over the declared target interval [0,1]
Retain all fixed eligible region denominators and equal-region weights
Keep finite-cohort identification bounds separate from observed-case scores and sampling intervals

inference_seams.issue: Source entity identity and consumed-byte provenance
inference_seams.check: Source territory identity validated; unknown entities flagged; consumed model/panel bytes hashed once; sealed packet shape/status/coverage checked.

inference_seams.action: Do not infer unchanged geographical footprint from persistent ID; record this limitation. Full polygon crosswalk is not mandatory for the proposed sensitivity claims.

decision_rule: A failed mechanism gate blocks the corresponding new claim/fit interpretation. An unavailable official MQ definition, unseen future outcomes or geometric footprint audit bounds the final scientific claim but does not block a useful corrected implementation. Contest success remains jury-evaluated.
